body.x: On January 9th at CES 2024 in Las Vegas, Intflow, a company specializing in bringing AI into the livestock industry, showed off its latest technology,’ EdgeSafe.’ This system automatically measures and records pigs’ number, weight, and health status based on their movement, which landed them the Innovation Award at CES 2024.

The ‘EdgeSafe’ system utilizes camera-based livestock disease prevention management by automatically measuring and recording pigs’ quantity, weight, and health status through their movements. Intflow, an agtech specialist, employs non-contact biometric analysis technology for innovative livestock industry solutions.

Among these solutions, ‘EdgeSafe’ focuses on farm inventory management, optimizing feed efficiency, and disease prevention. It analyzes the activities of pigs through CCTV installed in pigsties using high-intelligence AI, specializing in inventory and specification management monitoring.

body.cap: Intflow demonstrating their latest technology, ‘EdgeFarm’ at CES 2024

body.x: Previously, farmers had to manually measure the weight of pigs by mobilizing themselves or a significant number of employees. However, with the introduction of ‘EdgeSafe,’ the number and weight of pigs moving through the corridor are now automatically measured and recorded, making the process even more convenient.

Moreover, by observing pigs through CCTV in the hovel, daily stock quantity, average activity level, average weight, etc., are recorded in a database. Farmers can easily monitor pig farming sites remotely with a PC or smartphone.

Edgesafe also allows the veterinarians to monitor the pigsty remotely without visiting the farm. It will enable them to confirm the effectiveness of disease prevention and treatment, especially during outbreaks. As a result, expectations are high that this will contribute to accelerating the digital transformation of the livestock industry.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition organized by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), takes place every January in Las Vegas, Nevada. It provides a comprehensive overview of global consumer electronics trends. The convention will run until January 12th.
